title: Typed-operation fault
description: One refusal as it crosses the interactive-job boundary: the job fault detail an app-owned job hands the framework and the Fault-lane page a typed operation publishes. Decoded by type, never by splitting text. `code` is the frozen code a caller branches on and a host renders its localized text by (at most 64 UTF-8 bytes); `origin` who refused; `message` the refuser's own detail (at most 256 UTF-8 bytes). Rust `semio_framework_plugin::app::TypedOperationFault`; TypeScript `decodeTypedOperationFaultV1` (`🎭️actor/🖼️wire-turn/🟦️.ts`).
